question: The famous Nauchandi Fair happens once a year in the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Uttar Pradesh**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• The Nauchandi Fair is held in Meerut Uttar Pradesh after a **few days of the Holi festival.**
 
• It is an annual Fair held at Nauchandi ground of Meerut.
 
• During this Fair Hindu devotees worship** ‘Nauchandi Devi’ and pay tribute to the great saint ‘Syed Salar’.**
 
• It is organized by the Municipal Corporation of Meerut.
 
• The Nauchandi Express train is named after this Fair. It runs between Meerut and Lucknow.
